attacks.claim: Dark mode is broken for day cards: `.day-card` hard-codes `background: #ffffff` while `--text` flips to near-white (#f2f2f7) in dark mode, so card headings and text become near-invisible white-on-white. About 30% of users use dark mode.

The mobile action bar is `position: fixed` at 72px height, but nothing reserves bottom space on `.planner` or `body`. It will cover the last tiles of Sunday (the last child of .planner) at the end of scroll, hiding Swap/overflow controls.
attacks.evidence: .action-bar { position: fixed; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; height: 72px; ... } / "Sunday is the last child of .planner"

attacks.claim: The most frequent planner action (adding to shopping list, 9.4/week, 64% on mobile) loses its one-tap tile button and now requires a multi-step flow through the recipe page, Ingredients tab, and servings sheet. The redesign optimizes for clutter and moves the core task further away, with no evidence it was tested.
attacks.evidence: "The old tile-level \"+ List\" button is removed to declutter tiles." / "tap the tile → recipe page → \"Ingredients\" tab → choose servings in the servings sheet → \"Add to list\""

attacks.claim: QA covers only light mode and a single mobile device (iPhone 14 Safari) plus desktop Chrome. Dark mode (30% of users) and the 360px Android range (most sessions are 360-414px) are untested, which is why the dark-mode and action-bar overlap defects passed.
attacks.evidence: "Visual QA vs Figma: Chrome 1440px (light), Safari iPhone 14 (light) — pass, pixel diffs < 1%."

attacks.claim: Rollout is 100% on day one with no staged percentage, so any defect reaches all web users before signals appear. The flag flip does mitigate this.
The watch list has no thresholds, owner, or rollback trigger. A drop in shopping-list additions per WAU, the likely regression, has no defined action point.
attacks.evidence: "Watch: planner page JS errors, shopping-list additions/WAU, planner bounce rate."

attacks.claim: "Generate shopping list" bulk-adds all planned recipes for the week with no stated confirmation or undo, unlike the single-recipe flow, which has an Undo toast.
attacks.evidence: "\"Generate shopping list\" (adds all planned recipes for the week)"
